_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: the event rate is 3 times higher in the 28-day risk window

agreement.claim: both engines report the same log incidence rate ratio, its SE and the age-ignored comparator
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: at most 2.8e-8. harness/selfcontrolled_examples.test.py refits the conditional multinomial likelihood directly (agreeing to 1e-6), and over 100 seeds shows leaving age out inflates the estimate by more than 0.2.

recovery.claim: the estimate is close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The tolerance separates the effect (1.10) from zero. Measured by harness/selfcontrolled_examples.test.py on seeds 0 to 99.
